data.one_liner: Full-featured Flutter UI SDK for Stream Chat, providing ready‑made chat widgets and theming.
data.what_it_does: It offers a collection of customizable Flutter widgets for building chat experiences, handling messages, media, reactions, threads, and more. The SDK integrates with Stream's backend services and includes offline storage, push notifications, and localization support.
use_when: You need a ready-made chat UI with rich media, reactions, threads, and typing indicators
You want tight integration with Stream's chat backend and prefer a declarative widget‑based approach
avoid_when: You require a completely custom chat UI from scratch
You are not using Stream as the backend service
strengths: Built‑in theming and customization via ThemeExtension
Supports all major platforms (mobile, web, desktop)
Handles media uploads, offline storage, and push notifications
weaknesses: Relies on Stream backend, limiting backend flexibility
Requires multiple native permissions and platform setup
Package size can be large due to many dependencies
data.setup_notes: Add Android photo_manager permissions, iOS file_picker and image_picker setup, video_player configuration, and macOS network client entitlement; follow each plugin's installation guide.
